reasons.label: Cancel reasons (staff)
reasons.help: The words for each cancel reason the team picks when it cancels an order. The reasons themselves are fixed, so reports can count them; you can change their words in both languages. "Other" always needs a note.

customer.label: Customer cancel
customer.help: cutoff: until when the customer can cancel his order himself with one tap — "confirmed" (the default): until you confirm it; "packed": until it is packed; "placed": never with one tap, only by asking; "off": the customer cannot cancel or ask. requests: after the cut-off he can ask to cancel until a courier is booked; the team approves or refuses the request. A paid order's cancel only records a refund request for you; no money moves by itself.

customerReasons.label: Cancel reasons (customer)
customerReasons.help: The reasons the customer can pick when he cancels or asks to cancel. Add, remove or reword them in both languages.

reasons.label: Hold reasons
reasons.help: The reasons the team picks when it puts an order on hold. Support sees the reason and the note on the order. A held order keeps its stock and is never cancelled by itself.

reviewHours.label: Check a held order after (hours)
reviewHours.help: When an order has been on hold this many hours, a call task asks a person to look at it again. It is never cancelled by itself. 0 = off.

waitHours.label: Wait for an advance (hours)
waitHours.help: How long an order waits for its advance payment before a person is asked to call the customer. It is never cancelled by itself. 0 = no deadline.

duplicates.label: Duplicate orders
duplicates.help: enabled: every new order is compared with the same phone number's open orders of the last "lookbackDays" days. The same item (style and colour) is a high match, the same style in another colour medium, the same category low. From "reviewFrom" up, the order waits in the review queue and is confirmed only after a person decides (not a duplicate, cancel it, hold it, put both in one parcel, or ask the customer); below it, the order only shows a note. autoHold: a high match goes on hold by itself (off by default). A real order is never blocked.

list.label: Internal flags
list.help: Flags the team can put on an order, such as "Call before sending". The customer never sees them.

maxChars.label: Longest order note (characters)
maxChars.help: How long one note on an order may be.

pageSize.label: Orders per page
pageSize.help: How many orders the order list loads at a time (at most 100).

replayHours.label: Remember a repeated press (hours)
replayHours.help: A button pressed twice (a slow network, a double tap) is done once: the order service keeps each command's answer this many hours and gives it back for the same request.

reasons.label: Edit reasons
reasons.help: Why the team changes an order (the customer called, a wrong number was typed, a size change …). The team picks one with every edit; the timeline and the audit log keep it with who and when. Add, remove or reword them in both languages.

channels.label: Where the customer asked
channels.help: Where the change came from (a phone call, WhatsApp, Messenger, in the shop …). Kept with every edit the team makes; the customer's own edits are marked as his, from his order page.

customer.label: Customer edits his order
customer.help: Off by default. enabled: the customer can change his phone, address or a size from his order page. until: "placed" — only while the order is new; "confirmed" — also after you confirm it, until packing starts. Never after a courier is booked. windowMinutes: minutes after placing (0 = only the step counts). maxEdits: saves per order. phone, address, size: what he may change; a size only to another size of the same piece at the same price, when it is in stock. Prices, discounts and the delivery charge never change; a changed address gets a call task so the team checks the delivery area.

reasons.label: Parcel refusal reasons
reasons.help: Why a customer did not take the parcel at the door (bought elsewhere, arrived after Eid …). The team picks one when it records a refused parcel; the reports count them. Add, remove or reword them in both languages.

twoSize.label: Two-size follow-up
twoSize.help: Off by default. enabled: when an order has the same piece in neighbouring sizes (S and M), the order gets "2 sizes — check". If the customer said in the bag that they are for different people, it is only a note and nobody is asked. askCustomer: his order page asks which he wants (keep all, or only one size); his answer takes the other sizes out before packing. callTask: the confirmation caller also gets a call. No answer: all are sent.

maxRows.label: Order export: most orders per file
maxRows.help: An export of more orders than this is refused with the count, so the filter can be narrowed (by view, status, payment method, channel or search).

columns.label: Order export: columns
columns.help: The columns of the order CSV, in this order. The customer's name, phone, e-mail and address go only to staff allowed to export personal details; the others never name a person.

delimiter.label: Order export: separator
delimiter.help: The character between the cells of the CSV file: a comma, a semicolon (some spreadsheets in Bangla or European settings) or a tab.

cancelReasons.CUSTOMER_AFTER_CONFIRM: Customer asked to cancel after confirming
cancelReasons.CUSTOMER_CHANGE_AFTER_BOOKING: Customer wants a change after booking
cancelReasons.NOT_ORDERED: Did not order (someone else used the number)

holdReasons.defective-item: Item defective, waiting for a replacement

flags.check-size: Check the size with the customer
